# Sandwich Security

> Local CCTV camera and video doorbell installation for Sandwich and East Kent. Wireless, solar, wired PoE and 4G systems, monitoring setup and Wi-Fi support. Fixed quotes after a credited survey.

Based Sandwich, Kent CT13. Serves Sandwich, Deal, Dover, Ash, Woodnesborough, Eastry, Wingham, Worth, Preston, Staple and the East Kent villages between.

Contact: hello@sandwichsecurity.co.uk | 07763 100 477 | WhatsApp 07763 100 477

## Firm boundaries

We install and configure cameras, doorbells, sensors and Wi-Fi support. We do not run a monitored intruder-alarm central-station service ourselves, that goes through an accredited monitoring partner. We have a qualified electrician on every job, so if a camera or floodlight needs a new circuit rather than an existing supply, we run it ourselves, no second contractor. We do not do structural building work or scaffolded access beyond a standard ladder.

## Pricing

Security survey: GBP 49, credited against the installation. One-off services and packages range from GBP 69 (camera relocation) to GBP 3,500 (larger shop and office PoE systems). Monthly care plans from GBP 9.95 to GBP 49.95, plus professional monitoring from GBP 79/month through an accredited partner. Full price list: https://sandwichsecurity.co.uk/pricing.html

## Discounts

5% off for pensioners. 5% off for enquiries booked over WhatsApp. Both apply to installation and one-off service pricing.
